title: Missing type check for `path_type`
detail: If `path_type` is not `None`, the `convert` method does not check if the value is of the correct type.
note: convert() does coerce the value to path_type.

title: Missing timeout
detail: The test `test_warn_on_reformatting_root` does not have a timeout set, which can lead to hanging tests if the filesystem root is slow to resolve.
note: A test; nothing here takes or needs a timeout.

title: Extraneous blank line output
detail: When progress display is disabled and the console is non-interactive, an extraneous blank line is printed.
note: Near the bug, but describes the blank line the PR removes when the display is disabled, not the one the planted condition prints.

title: Incomplete handling of keep-alive connections
detail: The `recv_body` method does not handle keep-alive connections correctly. It should reset the parser and close the stream when a keep-alive connection is detected.
note: recv_body isn't where keep-alive is handled.

title: Incomplete handling of keep-alive connections
detail: The `handle_requests` method does not handle keep-alive connections correctly. It should reset the parser and close the stream when a keep-alive connection is detected.
note: handle_requests resets the parser after each exchange.

title: Incorrect logic for determining if a leaf starts a statement
detail: The function `_starts_statement` incorrectly checks if a leaf starts a statement by looking for a newline before the statement. This can lead to incorrect formatting when two `# fmt: skip` statements are in a row.
note: Flags the right function, but its reason (a newline check) isn't what's wrong; it restates the PR's title.
